title: papyrus whoami: person, selected Account, handle and client, via GET /v1/identities/me
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. `papyrus whoami` shows the person and the account. Ready now (`GET /v1/identities/me` is shipped).

## Change
- Route `app/cli/whoami/route.ts`: `GET` with the bearer access token (and the ID token header) -> `GET /v1/identities/me` as the site role; returns `{person: {id, createdAt} | null, account: {id, name, role} | null, handle}` where `account` is the `X-Prospectus-Account` selection validated with one `authorize(console:read)` call, and `handle` the staff `UserProfile.publicHandle` for this login (read with the user's own token, as the settings page does). Passes `reenrollment_required` through.
- CLI `whoami` (`src/papyrus_content/cli_user_auth.py` `command`, routes `login|logout|whoami|auth`): prints Site, Signed in as (email from the ID token, local display only, never logged), Person (id last 4 characters + createdAt), Account (name and role, or "none selected"), Handle, Enrolled: yes/no, Client: main|federation (from discovery). `--json` for scripts (full ids there, since it is the person's own terminal).
- Console: the settings page (`components/settings-page.tsx`) shows the same facts under "Your account" (Lucide `user`, `building-2`, `badge-check` icons, text labels; "Account", never "Organization").

## Gherkin (`features_backend/cli-whoami.feature`)
  Scenario: An enrolled login shows the person, the selected account and the handle
  Scenario: An unenrolled login shows Enrolled: no and how to fix it
  Scenario: A re-bound login reports reenrollment_required and exits non-zero
  Scenario: whoami never logs the email or tokens

## Acceptance
CLI and route tests; `docs/cli-login.md` "whoami". Ready now; shares `cli_user_auth.py` with the enrollment and account tasks (land after them or coordinate).
